assumptions.choice: Construct M5 and M15 OHLCV bars inside the strategy by aggregating the sole M1 feed into clock-aligned 5-minute and 15-minute buckets.
assumptions.reason: The fixed harness supplies only one M1 data feed, so separate M5 and M15 feeds cannot be consumed as written.

assumptions.choice: Process and retain the latest completed M5 and M15 bars without adding a filter to the stated M1 RSI entry and exit signals.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires processing those timeframes but states no M5 or M15 indicator, threshold, or condition; making them alter an order would invent an unstated trading rule.
